notes.title: Version 1.0.6 - Update notes
notes.content:
New Game Mode:
- "Infinite Waves" mode (with online leaderboard)

New Power Ups:
- Wololo wave
- Gem cannon
- Weapon efficiency
- Phoenix Weapon
- Mothership emergency energy recharge

More new features, improvements and stuff:
- Support drone: Level to 10 + better algorithm
- Dark matter bomb: Level to 10 + new animations
- Restart match option in pause menu
- Difficulty re-balanced
- New color pallet for menues
- Better power up texts
- Possibility to skip main menu animation
